episodes.title: The Awakening
episodes.summary: Gripping drama based on the most-documented account of poltergeist activity in British history. Timothy Spall, Matthew Macfadyen and Juliet Stevenson star.

episodes.title: The Quickening
episodes.summary: Following the poltergeist's attack, Janet is sent to a neighbour's for safety. Maurice finds a lead on the ghost's origin and tries to convince Guy to bring in the Society for Psychical Research. But the strange activities become more dangerous.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Having persuaded Mrs Hodgson to let them back in the house, Guy and Maurice attempt a Disobsession of the spirit, despite the risk to Janet and the family. Can they finally rid the house of evil and come out unscathed themselves?
